card.title: GLADIATOR Mk I
card.flavorText: The Gloster Gladiator (or Gloster SS.37) was a British biplane fighter. It was used by both the Royal Air Force (RAF) and the Fleet Air Arm (FAA) (as the Sea Gladiator variant). Although the Gladiator was the last biplane fighter aircraft put in service by the RAF it was used throughout WWII and saw action in almost all theaters of the war.
